name: zmodel_matl_slot_release
description: zModel_MatlSlot::Release frees owned animated-cycle storage, clears the material payload, unlinks the slot from the active list, pushes it to the free list, and decrements material-pool usage.
known_limits: Tier C only; no accepted VC COFF byte comparison exists yet, so tier S remains open.
The free calls for material-cycle storage are validated by exercising heap-owned frame table and cycle allocations without double-freeing them after release.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x480dc0 has no current warnings and validates null return, flag 0x0400 owned-cycle cleanup, frame-table free, cycle free, 40-byte material payload zeroing, active-list unlink, free-list insertion, and g_zModel_MatlPoolInUseCount decrement.

The dependency frontier for 0x480dc0 reports no visible source blockers; zModel_MatlSlot::IndexFromPtrOrMinus1 is already functionally accepted, and the indirect call is the free provider loaded from the imported runtime boundary.

Native smoke zmodel_matlslot_release_smoke verifies null release leaves pool globals unchanged, releasing a middle active slot rewires neighboring active links, clears the material payload and owned cycle pointer, pushes the slot to the free head, and decrement in-use count; it then releases the active head and verifies active-head promotion plus free-list relinking.
